newsitem.title: SWEDEN: P&U in $55 mln deal with IBM.
newsitem.headline: P&U in $55 mln deal with IBM.

text.p: Swedish/U.S. drug company Pharmacia & Upjohn (P&U) and IBM Global Services signed a $55 million deal under which IBM would take care of P&U's information systems.
"A contract has been signed between IBM Global Servies and drugs giant Pharmacia & Upjohn.
"The contract states that Pharmacia & Upjohn will turn over operation and maintenance of its large computer system for its Swedish and U.S. offices to IBM," IBM Svenska AB said in a statement.

IBM will streamline and modify P&U information technology systems so they function after the year 2000, it said. The five-year contract was signed in December and is worth around $55 million, it said.
IBM had previously provided PC support for Pharmacia & Upjohn in Stockholm.
